item.title: [7] Cooper condensation and pair wave functions in systems of strongly correlated electrons
item.description:
Last authors: Johannes S. Hofmann, Alexander Wietek

Authors: Hannes Karlsson, Johannes S. Hofmann, Alexander Wietek

Score 7/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Theoretical study of Cooper condensation in strongly correlated electron systems, relevant to unconventional SC.

Tags: #superconductivity #stronglycorrelated #Hubbard #theory

Abstract: Here, the authors present a framework for identifying superconducting order directly from the two-particle reduced density matrix, via the Penrose-Onsager criterion. Beyond detecting a condensate, the method reconstructs the Cooper pair wave function and resolves its symmetry without prior assumptions. Applied to the Hubbard model, it characterizes uniform s -wave, finite-momentum FFLO, and fragmented supersolid states — the last revealing an unexpected triplet p -wave component alongside the dominant d wave.
